purpose: Phase-8A washout abstraction: ordinal recovery-interval stages after treatment withdrawal. Washout drives tolerance/adaptive-state resolution and is a prerequisite for testing persistence (a state that resolves during washout is NOT persistent). Real-world durations are NOT defined without evidence - stages are ordinal simulation-stage abstractions only.

coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic recovery the extended-washout stage represents
coefficient_policy.source: general treatment-withdrawal recovery biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: relative_recovery scales tolerance/adaptive resolution; it does not by itself remove persistent resistance.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No real washout duration (hours/days) is defined (NOT_REPORTED).

rules.no_washout_during_exposure: A washout transition is illegal during active uninterrupted exposure (validation rejects it).
rules.persistence_gate: Only a state surviving extended_washout may be evaluated as persistent.
